crewPositions.name: Pilot
crewPositions.description: Flies the vehicle — keeps everyone safe and positions the ship wherever necessary. Benefits from one Pilot Only Manoeuvre per round (a second is available for 2 System Strain).

manoeuvres.name: Accelerate / Decelerate
manoeuvres.description: Increase or decrease vehicle speed by 1 or more, up to maximum speed. The vehicle suffers 1 System Strain for each increase/decrease over 1.

manoeuvres.name: Reposition
manoeuvres.description: Move the vehicle 1 range band — carefully position within the environment, close the distance, or become Engaged (e.g. to dock).

manoeuvres.name: Evade
manoeuvres.description: Dodge incoming fire. Upgrade the difficulty of attacks against the vehicle, and of attacks made by the vehicle, until your next turn.

manoeuvres.name: Brace for Impact
manoeuvres.description: The vehicle can suffer System Strain instead of Hull Trauma, up to its Silhouette. You may also suffer System Strain (up to Silhouette) to reduce collision damage by 10 per point suffered.

actions.name: Dangerous Driving
actions.description: An improbable feat of piloting prowess. Piloting check, difficulty equal to the vehicle's Silhouette, further modified by its current speed. Can help shake pursuit, and is sometimes a mandatory check the GM calls for.

actions.name: Gain the Advantage
actions.description: Dogfight for an advantageous position over one target vehicle. Difficulty is based on relative speed: faster than target ♦, same speed ♦♦, slower ♦♦♦, 2+ speeds slower ♦♦♦♦. Success upgrades your combat checks against the target twice, and upgrades the target's combat checks against you twice. The target can later spend an action to try to cancel this (same check, +1 difficulty).

actions.name: Fire Forward Weapons (Slaved)
actions.requirement: Forward-arc weapon, no seated gunner needed
actions.description: Slaves the ship's forward-facing weapon(s) to the pilot's own console and fires them as a crude, automated volley — locking the turret dead ahead or running a rudimentary auto-fire routine rather than tracking a target properly. Resolves as the Gunner's Fire [Weapon] action, but add ⬛ Setback to the check for the system's lack of finesse and the pilot's divided attention.

crewPositions.name: Copilot
crewPositions.description: Runs the support console — plots the course, jams enemy comms, coordinates fire, and keeps the ship's systems a step ahead of whatever's shooting at it.

manoeuvres.name: Assist the Pilot
manoeuvres.description: Spend your manoeuvre helping execute one of the Pilot's own manoeuvre options above.

actions.name: Plot Course (Piloting)
actions.description: Each uncancelled success reduces the Setback suffered for difficult terrain by one.

actions.name: Plot Course (Perception)
actions.description: Same effect as the Piloting version of Plot Course, at a higher difficulty.

actions.name: Copilot
actions.description: Each uncancelled success downgrades the difficulty of the pilot's next Piloting check once.

actions.name: Jamming
actions.description: Forces the enemy to make an Average Computers check to use communications. Difficulty increases per additional success, and jamming affects additional targets per Advantage spent.

actions.name: Boost Defenses
actions.description: The vehicle suffers 1 System Strain and increases Defense by one until the start of your next turn. Each additional success extends the duration by one round.

actions.name: Fire Discipline (Leadership)
actions.description: The next crew member firing a weapon adds a Boost die (additional crew members can be added per extra success). May spend Advantage to let hits inflict 1 System Strain on the target.

actions.name: Fire Discipline (Discipline)
actions.description: Same effect as the Leadership version of Fire Discipline, alternate skill.

actions.name: Scan the Enemy
actions.description: Learn what weapons the target vehicle has, its modifications, and its System Strain/Hull Trauma thresholds. Spend Advantage to also learn its current System Strain and Hull Trauma levels.

actions.name: Hack Enemy's Systems
actions.description: Reduce the target vehicle's Defense to 0 for one round per success. A Triumph may compromise a weapon of the character's choice; spending Advantage can inflict 1 System Strain on the target.

actions.name: Intercept Projectiles (Vigilance)
actions.description: Upgrades the difficulty of incoming Guided-weapon attacks against the vehicle once (plus once per additional success), until the start of your next turn.

actions.name: Intercept Projectiles (Computers)
actions.description: Same effect as the Vigilance version of Intercept Projectiles, alternate skill.

crewPositions.name: Gunner
crewPositions.description: Fires the vehicle's weapons — and heckles the pilot. That's it.

manoeuvres.name: Aim
manoeuvres.description: Add a Boost die to your next combat check this round. A second manoeuvre (suffer 2 strain, or forego your action) lets you Aim Twice for two Boost dice.

actions.name: Fire Forward Weapon
actions.description: Each vehicle weapon can be fired once per round as an action, within its firing arc (GM-adjudicated, narrative). Difficulty by range: Engaged –, Short ♦, Medium ♦♦, Long ♦♦♦, Extreme ♦♦♦♦, Strategic ♦♦♦♦♦. +1 difficulty if the target is 2+ Silhouette smaller; −1 if 2+ Silhouette larger. Hull Trauma inflicted = weapon damage + successes, minus the target's Armor.

actions.name: Fire Discipline (Leadership)
actions.description: The next crew member firing a weapon adds a Boost die (additional crew members can be added per extra success). May spend Advantage to let hits inflict 1 System Strain on the target.

actions.name: Fire Discipline (Discipline)
actions.description: Same effect as the Leadership version of Fire Discipline, alternate skill.

actions.name: Intercept Projectiles (Gunnery)
actions.description: Upgrades the difficulty of incoming Guided-weapon attacks against the vehicle once (plus once per additional success), until the start of your next turn.

crewPositions.name: Engineer
crewPositions.description: Keeps the ship running and its systems humming — repairs damage, manages system loads, and pitches in on sensor/comms work when nothing's actively on fire.

manoeuvres.name: Assist the Pilot
manoeuvres.description: Spend your manoeuvre helping execute one of the Pilot's own manoeuvre options above.

actions.name: Damage Control
actions.description: Choose one: reduce Hull Trauma (once per encounter), reduce System Strain (unlimited uses), or repair a Critical Hit (unlimited uses). Difficulty scales with the chosen track's current total: below half threshold ♦, at/above half ♦♦, exceeding threshold ♦♦♦ (Critical Hit repair: as per the critical hit). Success reduces the chosen track by 1 per uncancelled success, or removes the Critical Hit.

actions.name: Manual Repairs
actions.description: Remove 1 Hull Trauma, plus 1 more per additional 2 uncancelled successes. Once per encounter — replaces Damage Control that encounter.

crewPositions.name: Support Crew
crewPositions.description: Supports the rest of the crew and gets the most out of the ship. Use your manoeuvre to assist the pilot (see the Pilot's Manoeuvre options), or suffer 2 personal strain to take a second manoeuvre.
